name: Flipt
description: Flipt is a fully managed feature flag solution that enables you to keep your feature flags and remote config next to your code in Git.
composeYaml:
services:
  flipt:
    image: 'docker.flipt.io/flipt/flipt:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'flipt-data:/var/opt/flipt'
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '--spider'
        - '--quiet'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15

meta.about: Feature flag solution with support for multiple data backends (alternative to LaunchDarkly).
